text:
Lawson Crouse scored 24 goals for Utah last season, and through 26 games this year he has 4. Our numbers aren't worried. Those 4 goals came on 6.0 expected goals (the quality of his chances), one of the higher totals on the Mammoth, and his 8.9% shooting sits well under his usual range. He keeps getting to the right spots; the puck hasn't gone in.

It's starting to. He scored in each of his last two games, and his ice time is up almost two minutes a night over his last ten, to 16:36. The rest of his game is in good shape: Utah gets 56% of the 5-on-5 chance quality with him on the ice, he has 66 hits, and his top speed ranks in the 94th percentile. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking adds a signature you might not expect from a 6'4" power forward: 18% of his setups came across the royal road (the pass through the middle of the slot) last season, against 7% for a typical forward. Our numbers project about 18 goals.
headline: Lawson Crouse is getting the looks again
